name: door-app
description: Finding your next job, the way it should be.

scripts.dev:demo: npm run gen-theme && electron-vite dev --mode demo
scripts.dev:onboard: npm run gen-theme && electron-vite dev --mode onboard
scripts.dev:demo:fresh: npm run gen-theme && electron-vite dev --mode demo-fresh
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run build:web && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never
scripts.package:dir: npm run build && npm run build:web && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --dir --publish never
scripts.record:gif: npm run build && DOOR_GIF_FRAMES="$PWD/.gif-frames" playwright test -c playwright.record.config.ts app.record && poetry -C .. run python "$PWD/../scripts/demo/app_gif.py" "$PWD/.gif-frames" && rm -rf .gif-frames
scripts.build:web: npm run gen-theme && vite build --config vite.web.config.mts
scripts.test:web: npm run build:web && playwright test -c playwright.web.config.ts
scripts.record:phone-gif: npm run build:web && DOOR_VIDEO_DIR="$PWD/.gif-frames" playwright test -c playwright.record.config.ts phone && poetry -C .. run python "$PWD/../scripts/demo/app_gif.py" "$PWD/.gif-frames" "$PWD/../docs/demo/phone.gif" --width 360 && rm -rf .gif-frames
scripts.test:journeys: npm run build && playwright test -c playwright.journeys.config.ts
scripts.test:journeys:core: npm run build && playwright test -c playwright.journeys.config.ts --grep @core
scripts.test:journeys:coverage: npm run build && JOURNEYS_COVERAGE=1 playwright test -c playwright.journeys.config.ts; tsx scripts/journeys-coverage.mts --min ${JOURNEYS_MIN:-0}
